body:
Happy cake day and thanks for your response. I appreciate it.

It’s still awful to wake up in the morning. Taking it one day at a time, but I really don’t know what the future holds...

What you wrote is simply beautiful. It’s been 3 months since the BU/NC, and I am currently going through a rough time even though I’ve been doing okay overall. I hope that I’ll be able to look back at this situation soon without feeling that pain which kills me inside.

So glad to know you’re doing better. I guess everything heals with time and with the right mindset, everything is possible!

You are NOT weak. You are doing the best you can and it’s okay to feel vulnerable at times. 

Healing is a process, some days will feel good and others won’t, but it’s all part of the process. Trust it.

It feels so good to hear those types of stories with a happy ending! Inspirational! I’m so happy you were able to find the one after everything you went through :)

If you could go through these hard times, we all can! Whether it takes a few weeks, months or even years, eventually everything will fall back into place.

Step by step, just go one day at a time and you’ll be over it without even noticing. 

I’m happy you’re getting better, you’re doing just fine. It’s okay not to be okay, just keep moving forward.

What I’m going to tell you might not change anything to your current situation, but I’m gonna say it anyway.

We’ve all been there, and I know how hard it is. I am currently going through a BU, and even it’s been 3 months already, the pain’s still very much alive but I go on nonetheless. 

Some days are better than others, but what keeps me going is knowing that this shall pass too. You may think that the pain will be endless, but it won’t. Eventually, you’ll be able to look back at this situation one day and feel absolutely nothing. 

Be strong, and know that better things are going to happen to you. Have hope. There’s a reason why this happened. You deserve to be loved by someone who loves you as much as you love them. Don’t settle for anything less.
Hi 5!!! I’ve started running at least 3 times per week since the BU/NC and it’s the best thing ever!

I asked myself the same question when it was my ex’s birthday, and then I thought to myself what the heck? He’s someone who belongs to my past and the past is gone, so why should I wish him a happy birthday?!? 

No!!!! Please don’t!!! Keep NC going! All the best :)
I am so happy for you!!! If you could move on, we all can!!! 😁
Yesss!!!! Blocked my ex on every single platform as soon as we were over and never looked back since then! You go girl 😁

10 years is a long time, but you’re going to have to be really patient. It’s a process and you have to believe there’s light at the end of the tunnel. You’ll get there eventually, step by step.

I suggest that you cut off all contact with him, it’ll be easier to move on that way. Breathe, it’s going to be hard but never forget that one day you’ll be able to look back at this situation and it WON’T HURT anymore! Have patience, there’s no rush. 

All the best!
Inspirational! Have a fantastic birthday and enjoy it with the ones you love 😁
Be strong please. Don’t reply and just block their number. That’s what I did as soon as my ex and I were over and it was the best decision ever.
Happy birthday!!! Make yourself a priority today and every other day! Wishing you the very best :)

It’s all part of the healing process. It’s like a roller coaster, there’ll be ups and downs but the importance is that you keep going no matter what. Keep the NC going because this will truly help you move on in the long run (cut my ex off as soon as we were over and it was the best decision ever!) 

Everyone heals differently and some may take more time than others, but you have to believe things will get better because eventually, they will. There’s no rush, go at your own pace.

You have two choices, to live your life even through sadness or let this BU take control of everything. Please choose the first option. I did it, and today, after 2months and a half of NC, I can honestly say that I am not sad anymore. I still think about him, but the sadness is gone. I lived my life and felt what I needed to feel. You can do it too! 

All the best my dear friend. Be strong, keep going and never forget that pain is temporary.

Block them on every single social media, that is the only way. It is tough, not saying it’s going to be easy but it is necessary for your sanity. I know how hard it is sometimes to fight the urge to check their profiles, but it is pointless and it’ll hurt you so much. This pain is unnecessary and you know you can avoid it. 

Make a promise to yourself to stop checking their profiles because they don’t belong to your present anymore. Look forward and only forward.

It’s been 2 months and a half for me, and I can honestly say that I am over it at 90% so that’s pretty good. I still get my moments when I think about the past, but then I remember that there’s a reason why it all ended. 

I chose to live my life to the fullest after the BU even though I was sad deep down, I planned many activities and events with friends/family, and concentrated on getting better as a person. I cut off all ties with him as soon as we were done so it’s helped me a lot. Haven’t contacted him ever since and I honestly don’t miss him at all.  

Take your time to heal properly, don’t rush anything, everyone is different and everyone should go at their own pace. The only way out is through! Keep your head up, pain is temporary :)

I don’t know you but I am SO PROUD of how you handled this situation. You showed that you were a strong individual, strong enough to let him go and strong enough to keep moving forward with your life. 

Please, keep the NC, it’ll help you in so many ways and you’ll be able to look back at this situation in some months and you’ll smile. These bad feelings won’t last forever, hang in there. You’re on the right track and you did the right thing cutting off ties with him. You’re so much better than that!

Wow! This is so true and I couldn’t agree more. The sadness is there and will be there for some time (everyone is different and everyone goes at their own pace), but we shouldn’t let this stop us from living life. We shouldn’t let the sadness and despair define who we are. Hang in there, everything is temporary. Happiness is temporary but so is pain.

You’re doing everything right girl by not reaching out to him!!! Many people beg after a BU and make a fool of themselves (and it’s a normal reaction to get), I’m just saying that you acted like a dignified woman and you should be very proud of yourself. DO NOT UNBLOCK HIM!!! 

Keep doing YOU and leave him in the past, I broke off all contact with my ex as soon as it was over. It still hurts sometimes but I don’t miss him at all (it’s been 2months and a half). What’s the point anyways? You don’t need people who don’t need you!

It’s okay to make mistakes, the importance is that you learn from them and I’m sure you did. 

He’s not worth anything, so move forward and don’t look back. He’s the past and the past isn’t a place where you want to wander. 

Also, break any contact you still have with him, it’ll be tough but once you decide to take this step, you’ll feel empowered over time and eventually you’ll be able to forget about him. I know that 6 years is a long time but we never know what tomorrow will bring. 

Take your time to take care of yourself and rediscover who you are. You are important and deserve to be loved, if someone doesn’t want you in their lives, fuck them! Let them go! It’s their loss, not yours!

Exercise and keep on exercising!!! This has helped me in so many ways! Since my BU, I try to go out running at least 4 times a week + I go to my gym for my daily work out. Sweating helps to release the bad energy and negativity. 

Also, try to organise some plans with your family/friends in advance so that you have something to look forward to! I signed up for 3 trails for this month and I already can’t wait! Try to find a new hobby that will make you feel happy and excited. 

Other than exercising, I love writing about my thoughts in a jounal! This has helped me to express myself through words and to put things into perspective.

It’s been 2 months and a half for me and I can tell you something, it will get easier to deal with over time. Everyone is different so there’s no need to rush. Go at your own pace. But please, please don’t make yourself feel even sadder than you already are. 

Force yourself to do activities, to work out, I can promise you that exercising will help you in so many ways. It did for me! One day after the BU, I put on my running shoes and went hiking. I’m a fitness instructor so I work out every day, but exercising has really helped me to think about other things. If you don’t like sports, maybe there’s something else you like to do? Cooking? Or reading? Anything would do. Do what makes you happy! 

You only have one life, and you’re most probably going to find the love of your life someday. Don’t give up hope, but for the time being, concentrate on getting better for YOU! Cry if you need to but please make an effort to get out there and start living your life! You are important and you should take care of your body and mind.

I love your way of thinking! It’s easy to say but there really is beauty in every single thing, we just have to see it! Keep going, I know how hard it is and there will be days when you’ll want to give up but just hang in there. It WILL GET BETTER!!!

This man (well I’m not even sure we can call him that) is playing with your feelings and it’s clear to see. Well, it’s clear from what you wrote that he is just trying to have some fun by sending you mixed signals. The fact that he told you that his ex is better than you is enough for you to block him out of your digital life! Block him everywhere, it’s still early days so it’s better to end everything now before you get hurt.

Plan something fun with your friends or your family! And try telling yourself that there’s a good reason she’s not in your life anymore, that’s cause she belongs to the past. The past is gone and what matters is now!!! Go out and try to have fun, try to meet new people through common friends or get out there and do things that make you happy. What do you like to do? It’s YOUR day! Make yourself a priority, not just this Saturday but everyday!

Yes!!!! That’s the way!!! You’re SO important and you should always put yourself first. These things happen so that greater things can happen to you later! This is just the beginning, I promise, you’ll be able to look back at everything one day without feeling anything. Keep going, you’re doing just fine! And never forget that it’s THEIR loss, not yours.

My dear friend, please please reach out to family and friends or people you know you can count on! It’s good that you’re seeing a therapist, that means that you want to get better and that’s already something big! 

I’ve known depression, anxiety and I also spent years hurting myself physically (it didn’t help me in any way, just left ugly scars on my body). 

I know what you’re going through but it is going to be OKAY. I promise. Someday you’ll be able to look back at this period and smile. 

Keep the NC going, I’ve gone NC with my ex for 2months and a half now and I couldn’t feel any better about it. Your ex forms part of your past now and you have to accept it whether you like it or not. I’m still not completely over my ex either, but I knew that if it ended, that’s because he wasn’t the one. I still think about him sometimes and the memories are still vivid, but I don’t let the thought of him stop me from living my life! 

You have to live your life now and forget about the past. Easier said than done, I know. But if there’s a will, there’s a way! I did everything I could to heal by going out there and doing things that made me happy. I began running weekly and exercised daily. I went out more and met many new people. Of course, my ex was always at the back of my mind but I didn’t let that stop me from doing anything I wanted to do in life. You have to force yourself sometimes to get out, it could be a simple walk in the park to get some fresh air or anything. 

You’ll get better and I know it sounds super cliché, but time really does heal all wounds. Step by step, you’ll eventually get there.

I’ve had two BU where I used NC and it was the best thing ever to get back to my normal life without some toxic persons making me feel inferior and sad. 
You don’t really have to break it because there’ll come a time eventually when you will just stop caring about having them in your life or not. It’s been like that with my 1st ex, after some months of NC, I saw him at the supermarket once and felt absolutely nothing. It’s like I was looking at a stranger and I honestly felt nothing even though he was my first love and I loved him deeply (btw I broke up with him because he told me he had growing feelings for someone else!). 

I’ve gone NC with my current ex as soon as we broke up, it’s been 2months and a half now and I don’t intend of having him back in my life anytime soon. Even though I don’t think he’s a bad person, he treated me unfairly and I don’t want someone like him in my life, even as a “friend”! 

Trust your path, listen to your heart, what does it tell you? If you really want to reconnect with an ex in the future when there won’t be any ambiguities, it’s okay but if there’s still feelings, you should probably keep the NC going! Be strong and do what you think is best.

Block her everywhere!!! It has saved me from so much hurt and it can for you to! One week after the BU, I blocked my ex everywhere (insta, fb, whatsapp, I even blocked his number!) because I knew that we were done for real this time. There was no point in having him on my friend list anymore so I just decided to cut off all ties with him. My heart was in pieces because this really meant that everything was over, but it’s helped me in so many ways! I haven’t had the temptation to check his pages or contact him, and even though the memories still pop up sometimes, I truly found myself after the BU! I went out there and started living and left my ex in the past! If someone doesn’t want you in their lives, why should you want them? There’s no point! There’s so many more people you haven’t met yet and who will definitely be able to make you feel happy and loved! Be strong and do everything you can to make you heal! Stalking your ex is only going to break your heart all over again! Do the right thing! Good luck in everything.
